en: Forward, people, to the fight back,
red flag, red flag;
forward, people, to the fight back,
the red flag will triumph.
The red flag, it will triumph,
the red flag, it will triumph,
the red flag, it will triumph,
long live communism and freedom!
Forward, people, the cannon thunders,
revolution, revolution,
forward, people, the cannon thunders,
revolution is what we want to make.
Revolution is what we want to make,
revolution is what we want to make,
revolution is what we want to make;
long live communism and freedom.
Red flag, where have you been?
you have come back, you have come back,
red flag, where have you been?
you have come back to wave.
Revolution is what we want to make,
revolution is what we want to make,
revolution is what we want to make;
long live communism and freedom.
You have come back with your hammer,
sickle and hammer, sickle and hammer,
you have come back with your hammer,
sickle and hammer will triumph.
Revolution is what we want to make,
revolution is what we want to make,
revolution is what we want to make;
long live communism and freedom.
From the fields to the sea, to the mines,
red flags, red flags,
from the fields to the sea, to the mines,
red flags will wave.
Revolution is what we want to make,
revolution is what we want to make,
revolution is what we want to make;
long live communism and freedom.
No more enemies, no more frontiers:
the borders are red flags,
O proletarians, to the fight back,
the red flag will triumph.
The red flag, it will triumph,
the red flag, it will triumph,
the red flag, it will triumph,
long live communism and freedom!
notes: line 1.1: 'alla riscossa' = to the counter-attack, to rise up and win back what was lost.
line 2.1: 'la trionferà': 'la' is the popular, northern Italian subject pronoun ('it'), repeating 'bandiera rossa'.
line 3.4: 'rivoluzione vogliamo far' = literally 'revolution we want to make'.
line 11.2: 'sono i confini rosse bandiere' = the borders are red flags (the only borders left are the red flags).
